title: SpaceX's $100B Insider Lock-Up Expires — Stock Rises 6.1% Instead of Falling
detail: SpaceX's post-IPO lock-up expired on August 6, 2026, releasing the first 20% tranche of eligible insider shares — up to 911.5 million shares worth an estimated $100 billion — for potential sale, more than doubling the stock's public float from about 4.9% to 11.8% of shares outstanding. Contrary to the conventional expectation that a large supply increase would pressure the price lower, SPCX shares closed up 6.1% on the day, after swinging between modest gains and losses of less than 3% in early trading, as the market judged the unlock as a step toward a more liquid, broadly tradable stock rather than a signal of insider exodus.

title: SpaceX and Tesla Confirm $16.8B 'Terafab' Chip Factory in Grimes County, Texas
detail: SpaceX and Tesla confirmed on August 6, 2026 that their jointly developed 'Terafab' semiconductor plant will be built in Grimes County, Texas, near College Station outside Houston, with a first-phase capital investment of $16.8 billion and at least 3,000 new jobs. Texas Governor Greg Abbott announced a $30 million Texas Enterprise Fund grant to support the project. The planned facility — over 100 million square feet, which Musk called the largest and most valuable building on Earth — will consolidate logic and memory chip manufacturing, packaging, and testing under one roof to supply Tesla's Optimus robots and Cybercab, and SpaceX's AI/Colossus compute buildout and space-based data centers. The announcement firms up an earlier, larger $55–119B proposal SpaceX filed for the site in May 2026.
